referenceSources.description:
A pristine white 1994 Toyota Celica ST205 GT4 is captured head-on, highlighting its distinctive round quad headlights, central mesh grille, and functional hood scoop. The UK license plate “L493 DUE” confirms its right-hand drive configuration and registration era.

This rare WRC Edition model features a manual five-speed transmission and retains its original rally-inspired styling cues. Parked on an asphalt surface before a dark tiled wall, the Celica’s clean lines and well-maintained bodywork emphasize its collectible status and single-owner history in Mells, United Kingdom.
